in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Celestial nymph, heavenly dancer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Apsara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Apsaras are celestial nymphs and attendants to the gods. They are depicted as beautiful, graceful, and skilled dancers who bring joy and harmony in the heavens.
